conclusion.statement: The bug was never executed for slake_open. The SLAKE open-text dump was produced by gen_slake_open_bestofN.py with the correct SLAKE images (byte-identical scores), the image ablation scored the true SLAKE images (all 483 'real' candidates reproduce the dump to <=5e-6), and the buggy path was structurally incapable of producing a non-empty SLAKE dump. The C_image_ablation conclusion that the verifier leans substantially on text priors on SLAKE therefore STANDS as published, and no re-run or correction is required. Transfer results for vqa_rad/pathvqa/kvasir/radimagenet went through correct branches and are likewise unaffected.
